[Unit]
Description=LimeOS fresh storage inventory (read only)
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=exec
User=root
Group=limeos-host-access
ExecStart=/usr/lib/limeos/limeos-executor /etc/limeos/system-policy/storage.json /run/limeos-storage-reader/executor.sock storage
RuntimeDirectory=limeos-storage-reader
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
UMask=0077
LimitCORE=0
MemorySwapMax=0
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
TimeoutStartSec=15s
TimeoutStopSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
# A mount namespace sandbox would hide or clone the host mount identity.
# This dormant reader has no effectful request, shell, write flag or capability.
PrivateMounts=no
PrivateDevices=no
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallArchitectures=native
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
LimitNOFILE=256
TasksMax=16
MemoryMax=64M
CPUQuota=50%
# Deliberately no Install section or package enable/start action.
